The triangle is the work.

Sight distance, stop bars, crosswalks, control. Cities send the study. Counsel sends the alleged defect. The practice tests both against accepted traffic-engineering practice.

01 Control of the assignmentTake / leave

Inside the sheet

TIS and VMT peer review. Circulation and access. Signing and striping review. Sight distance. Stop-control studies. Safety and operations. Staff-extension opinions. Roadway forensic review.

Off the sheet

Traffic-count programs. CAD mills. Signal design packages. Regional models. Public outreach. Open-ended project management. Vehicle reconstruction.
